mapper.select: SELECT /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.CaseTrprInfoMapper.selectCaseTrprInfoList(사례대상자정보 목록조회) */ COUNT(*) FROM SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ , SEB100 T2 /* 사례기본 */ , SEB150 T3 /* 사례담당자 */ WHERE T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T3.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y'

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.bizcmmns.cmmns.CaseTrprInfoMapper.selectCaseTrprInfoList(사례대상자정보 목록조회) */ T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , T1.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD AS CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD -- 사례대상자선정일자 , T4.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 , T4.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명암호화 , T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 , T1.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T2.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD -- 사례시작일자 , T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD -- 사례종결일자 , T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD -- 단위업무구분코드 , T3.CASE_PIC_NO AS CASE_PIC_NO -- 사례담당자번호 ,(SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T3.CASE_PIC_NO) AS CASE_PIC_NM -- 사례담당자명 , T3.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO -- 담당자기관번호 ,(SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = T3.PIC_INST_NO) AS PIC_INST_NM -- 담당자기관명 , T1.TRPR_TELNO AS TRPR_TELNO -- 대상자전화번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT -- 휴대전화번호암호화 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR_ENCPT -- 이메일주소암호화 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) AS MSNGR_ID_ENCPT -- 메신저아이디암호화 , CASE WHEN T5.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD = '00' THEN TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(T5.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM')),'YYYYMMDD') WHEN T5.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD = '99' THEN TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(T5.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM'), 1)),'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(T5.DDLN_YM,'YYYYMM'), 1), 'YYYYMM') || T5.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD END AS DDLN_CRTR_YMD /* 마감기준년월 */ , T5.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , T5.DDLN_YM AS DDLN_YM /* 마감년월 */ , T5.DDLN_YN AS DDLN_YN /* 마감여부 */ , T5.DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD AS DDLN_APLCN_CRTR_SE_CD /* 마감적용기준구분코드 */ FROM SEA200 T1 /* 대상자정보 */ , SEB100 T2 /* 사례기본 */ , SEB150 T3 /* 사례담당자 */ , (SELECT RM , TRPR_INFO_NO , MNG_SN , ACBG_SE_CD , GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY T.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY T.TRPR_INFO_NO DESC) AS RM , T.* FROM SEA230 T WHERE 1 = 1 AND T.ACBG_SE_CD NOT IN ('01','91','92') ) WHERE RM = 1) T4 /* 학력상태 */ , (SELECT TT5.* FROM SEC330 TT5 /* 사례관리마감 */ WHERE 1=1 AND TT5.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND TT5.DDLN_YN = 'Y' AND TT5.DDLN_YM = ( SELECT MAX(DDLN_YM) FROM SEC330 WHERE INST_NO = TT5.INST_NO AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = TT5.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD ) ) T5 WHERE T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T4.TRPR_INFO_NO(+) AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T3.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND T3.PIC_INST_NO = T5.INST_NO(+)
ORDER BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SEB150 WHERE CASE_MNG_NO = T2.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND CASE_PIC_NO = #{ENFSN_NO})
